scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm bundle && pnpm smoke:bundle
scripts.bundle: pnpm bundle:lambda && pnpm bundle:local && pnpm bundle:browser
scripts.bundle:lambda: esbuild src/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/lambda.mjs
scripts.bundle:local: esbuild src/local.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/local.mjs
